title: rs_crossexam_result_response
description: Structured output for a readiness-score cross-examiner of a scoring evaluator (rubric or coverage). Re-score the assigned evaluator in light of the other evaluators' anonymized findings.

revised_score.description: The revised 0-100 score. Keeping it unchanged is allowed ONLY with an explicit defense against the most damaging finding.

delta.description: revised_score minus the original score. Negative when cross-examination lowered the score.

most_damaging_finding.description: The single finding across ALL results (including this evaluator's own cons) most damaging to the plan if true. Quote it.

verdict_on_finding.description: Whether the most damaging finding holds up against the available evidence.

discarded_pros.description: Any of this evaluator's round-1 pros contradicted by its own cons. Empty array if none.

revision_reason.description: One sentence explaining the revision (or the defense of an unchanged score).
